eventLocation: Agaram village, near Walajabad in Kanchipuram District.
eventDescription:
A 50-year-old Peepal tree in Agaram village, near Walajabad in Kanchipuram District, which was obstructing the construction work of a Shiva Temple, was safely rescued and successfully replanted at another location, giving it a new lease of life.
Cutting down trees is not the solution? Protecting and preserving them is our responsibility!
If we protect nature, nature will protect us!
